Here are the things I have asked ChatGPT now:
"What does "MV" stand for in RPG Maker MV?"
"In RPG Maker MV, "MV" stands for "Multi-Platform and Multi-Language Version". RPG Maker MV is a game development software that allows users to create role-playing games (RPGs) for various platforms, such as Windows, MacOS, iOS, Android, and HTML5. It also supports multiple languages, making it easier for game developers to reach a wider audience."
"What does "MZ" stand for in RPG Maker MZ?"
"In RPG Maker MZ, "MZ" stands for "Maker Zero". RPG Maker MZ is the latest version of the RPG Maker software, released in 2020, and it includes a number of new features and improvements over its predecessor, RPG Maker MV. The "Maker Zero" moniker is meant to represent a fresh start for the software, with new tools and capabilities designed to empower game developers to create even more complex and engaging RPGs."
"Why does it stand for "Maker Zero"? What does "Maker Zero" mean?"
"The term "Maker Zero" in RPG Maker MZ is intended to convey a sense of starting anew and creating something from scratch. The "Zero" part of the name emphasizes this concept, as it suggests a blank slate or an empty canvas, ready to be filled with new ideas and creations.
The makers of RPG Maker MZ likely chose this name to emphasize the software's focus on empowering game developers to create their own unique RPGs without being limited by pre-existing templates or constraints. The term "Maker Zero" encourages users to approach game development with a fresh perspective and to embrace their creativity to build something entirely new and unique."

Part of GGG's problem is its business model. Because they make most of their money upfront they have less incentive to keep updating or improving the engine. I think most would go to general purpose engines - Unity, Godot, GameMaker, etc. Some would go to other RPG engines: Bakin, Architect, WolfRPG etc. Some would quit/go to another hobby. The answer to that question are RPG Maker's current threats.
